recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If FHIR-55478 later reaches Applied or Published status, reconcile that deprecation separately rather than changing this historical definition audit.
issue_request: FHIR-18702 was a Published/Persuasive Vocab change request for ValueSet.compose.lockedDate. It asked to replace explanatory usage-note wording with a definition stating that Locked Date is the effective date used to determine versions of referenced Code Systems and Value Set Definitions in the Content Logical Definition that are not already tied to a specific version.
initial_application: The Jira comment records git 4907f9bcb0b710cb2837a93a20c4b23210a37249. That commit changed source/valueset/valueset-spreadsheet.xml from the older explanatory wording to the requested effective-date definition, and later source migrations carried the text into source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml.
additional_context: ValueSet is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current StructureDefinition for ValueSet.compose.lockedDate contains the effective-date definition plus the related FHIR-16435 short text for references with no specified version. FHIR-10490 and FHIR-16435 are earlier same-element clarifications that are consistent with the current text. FHIR-55478 proposes deprecating lockedDate, but it remains Triaged/indeterminate rather than Applied or Published and does not supersede this reconciliation.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scope source already reflects the FHIR-18702 definition; the remaining double space in the definition and the generated SVG punctuation difference are editorial/generated-surface details that do not change implementer understanding.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published lockedDate wording issue established that the date applies to versionless code system/value set references rather than every reference.
Earlier Published clarification supplies the current short description for references with no specified version.
Triaged 2026 deprecation proposal is relevant context but is not an Applied/Published source-edit decision for this run.
